mfa.title: Two-step verification
mfa.codeHint: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
mfa.recoveryHint: Enter one of your recovery codes. Each code works only once.
mfa.setupHint: Two-step verification is required. Scan this QR code with an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password…), then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
mfa.qrAlt: QR code to scan with your authenticator app
mfa.manualEntry: Can't scan? Enter this key manually:
mfa.codesHint: If you lose your phone, each of these codes lets you sign in once. They will not be shown again: keep them somewhere safe.
mfa.copyFailed: Copy failed: write the codes down by hand.
mfa.expired: Sign-in expired. Enter your password again.
mfa.throttled: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.name: Name (e.g. phone)
notifications.enabledHint: Enabled — untick to mute without losing the token
notifications.empty: No target yet. Create one with the apt_… token of a PushIT application.
notifications.intro: Fabric notifies you on your phone through PushIT — above all when Claude is waiting on you.
